ValidationRule.description: Enforces the FSD 5.9.5 Case Reason to Resolution Path mapping on the Delinquency record type: Non-payment and Short payment must route to Collect, Billing dispute and Prior-owner balance must route to Correct. Inert while either field is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Delinquency", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Resolution_Path__c))), OR( AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Non-payment"), ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Short payment")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Resolution_Path__c, "Collect")) ), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Billing dispute"), ISPICKVAL(Reason, "Prior-owner balance")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Resolution_Path__c, "Correct")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Non-payment and Short payment must use the Collect path. Billing dispute and Prior-owner balance must use the Correct path - fix the charge in Yardi rather than chasing the tenant.
